items.excerpt: Text-to-music systems produce increasingly convincing audio, yet evaluation reveals little about whether the result matches user intent. items.title: High-Fidelity Song Generation with Joint Discrete and Continuous Modeling
items.excerpt: Generating a full song from lyrics and a style description requires long-range musical planning without sacrificing vocal and instrumental detail. Low-rate discrete semantic tokens make this tractable, but quantization constrains the information available to acoustic rendering, while separately optimized stages prevent downstream generation objectives from shaping the planner.

items.title: Introducing Instant Soundtracks
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs launched Instant Soundtracks in ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic and the API: upload a video and the model scores it with original music, then detects moments that need sound effects and places them on the timeline as separately editable layers; existing audio can be used as a reference for genre, tempo or instrumentation.
